# AI-Swarm

> Multi-agent SDLC orchestrator: transforms Jira issues into detailed work plans via a 5-stage pipeline.
> Integrates with Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) and GitHub via MCP servers. LLM: DeepSeek.

## Docs

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md)
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Config reference](config/sdlc_config.example.yaml)
- [Environment template](.env.example)

## Entry Points

```bash
python execute.py --task PROJ-123                        # Full 5-stage pipeline
python execute.py --task PROJ-123 --output-format json   # Machine-readable output
python execute.py --phase0 PROJ-123                      # Phase 0: Backlog Analysis
python execute.py --refine PROJ-123 --feedback "..."     # Refine with feedback
python src/executor/mcp/pipeline_server.py               # Expose pipeline as MCP server
```

## MCP Server (agent-to-agent)

Start: `python src/executor/mcp/pipeline_server.py`

Tools:
- `run_pipeline(issue_key, dry_run?)` — Full pipeline → Work Plan JSON
- `run_phase0(issue_key, dry_run?)` — Backlog Analysis → Use Cases + DoR
- `refine_plan(issue_key, feedback)` — Refine plan with human feedback

## Pipeline Stages

1. Trigger — parse Jira issue key
2. Jira Enrichment — fetch issue details, comments, assignee
3. Confluence + GitHub + Templates — project knowledge retrieval
4. Data Aggregation — unified ExecutionContext
5. LLM Execution — DeepSeek generates work plan

## Output

Files in `outputs/{ISSUE_KEY}/`:
- `{KEY}_work_plan.md` — generated work plan
- `{KEY}_pipeline_metrics.json` — structured metrics with trace_id
- `{KEY}_context_store.json` — serialized context for refinement

## Key Source Files

- `execute.py` — CLI entry point
- `src/executor/mcp/pipeline_server.py` — MCP server (pipeline as tools)
- `src/executor/phases/context_builder.py` — Stages 1–4
- `src/executor/phases/llm_executor.py` — Stage 5 (LLM)
- `src/executor/phases/phase_zero.py` — Phase 0 and 0.5
- `src/executor/models/execution_context.py` — core data models
- `src/executor/mcp/client.py` — MCP client manager

## Configuration

- `.env` — credentials (Atlassian, DeepSeek, GitHub)
- `config/sdlc_config.yaml` — workflow config (Jira statuses, LLM params, layer taxonomy)
